entries.opening: Two fields decide whether a post goes out now or later.

steps.text: A post publishes immediately when no scheduling fields are provided, meaning scheduledTime and useNextFreeSlot are both left out.

cite.quote: No scheduling fields are provided (scheduledTime and useNextFreeSlot are both omitted)

steps.text: If both are provided, scheduledTime takes priority over useNextFreeSlot.

cite.quote: scheduledTime takes priority over useNextFreeSlot

steps.text: Using useNextFreeSlot: true needs a matching slot in the Weekly posting schedule, and without one the request returns a validation error.

cite.quote: If no matching slot or available time is found, post creation returns a validation error.

steps.text: Do not remove the scheduling field to get past the error, because a request without scheduling publishes immediately.

cite.quote: Do not remove the scheduling field to bypass the error, since a request without scheduling publishes immediately.

entries.next: Add scheduledTime with an explicit UTC offset or Z, or create matching slots in the Weekly schedule before using useNextFreeSlot.
entries.proof: You will know it worked when the post shows as scheduled instead of published.
